Nick could write a story about the party!

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: That doesn't make sense...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Think, $ZOE. Most mascots are animals, right? So it was probably some kind of wild, menacing animal...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Oh! That's right! It was a...

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Uh... I guess this one is kind of close...
After a few seconds of flipping through the yearbook...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: He's not in here! Maybe it was a different animal... I'm sorry, I just can't remember.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: We'll just have to go through all of the yearbooks.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: But there's no way we can finish in time! The game will be over before we even find the right school!

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Here, Autumn and I can help you.

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: Everyone, take a stack. We've got a lot of yearbooks to go through.
About an hour later...

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: There he is! Got it! Owen Harris.
Autumn tosses $ZOE a yearbook with a page open to a picture of Owen. $ZOE looks at the cover.
Owen, Spencer, and the rest of the Twin Branches Squirrels play tough defense, preventing the San Adino Warriors from scoring many points over the next few quarters.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Yeah! Go Squirrels!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Looking good, Owen!

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: Huzzah! Our team is operating well above statistical averages!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Look at that crowd! We really might stand a chance after all!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: We... We lost...

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: And it's all your fault, New Guy!
Nate picks himself up, stumbles over to Owen, and shoves him hard! Owen shoves back, and the entire Twin Branches team joins in the growing brawl!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Owen, Nate... What are you doing?
Nate shoves Owen back into $ZOE, and they both fall to the ground.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: `Ow!` That hurt!
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]Ow![/i][/color] That hurt!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: $ZOE, I'm sorry. I didn't mean to...
$ZOE gets to her feet, crying. She turns and runs off, leaving Owen and Nate in the middle of the brawl.
Owen watches her go, knowing in his heart of hearts...
...He has failed.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: `Rarrrr!!!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]Rarrrr!!![/i][/color]

nodes.text: Owen leaps forward, throwing himself in front of the linebacker with every ounce of strength in his body.
He expects his mind to drift back...
But it doesn't. Instead his mind is focused utterly and completely on the present!
Owen and the linebacker collide with a chunky, satisfying crunch.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: `Ha! Got you!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]Ha! Got you![/i][/color]

nodes.text: All clear, Nate finds an open receiver. He winds up to throw a pass when...
A defensive end leaps up and slaps at the ball! It pops straight up into the air!

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: Oh no...
A gasp rolls through the stands, and fans leap to their feet to see what will happen next!
Owen scrambles to his feet, hands forward, palms up. The football drops into his outstretched arms.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: I... I caught it!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Owen, don't just stand there... `Run!`
nodes.text_bbcode: Owen, don't just stand there... [color=#e23b3b][i]Run![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Oh, right!
Owen tucks the football against his chest and sprints toward the end zone. From the sidelines, the crowd cheers him on!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Keep going, Owen!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: You're almost there!
Owen leaps over a defender diving for his ankles. Then up ahead, two bulky Warriors' safeties position themselves between Owen and the end zone. Owen drops his shoulder, bashes them both aside...

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: `Rarrr!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]Rarrr![/i][/color]

nodes.text: ...And topples into the end zone! A nearby ref throws his arms straight up!

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: `Yes! Touchdown! We win!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]Yes! Touchdown! We win![/i][/color]

nodes.text: The clock runs out. An air horn blast signals the end of the game!
Owen pivots too quickly, and his feet slide out from beneath himself. He goes belly down on the grass!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]Uff...[/i][/color]

nodes.text: The linebacker doesn't even slow down. He drops his shoulder and hits Nate low. There's a wet, sickening crunch, and Nate wilts, letting the football drop from his hands.

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: `Ahh!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]Ahh![/i][/color]

nodes.text: The linebacker scoops it up and races upfield, carrying the ball all the way to the end zone. The Warriors score a touchdown!
The clock runs out. An air horn blast signals the end of the game!
Owen slows his stride...

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Huh...
The linebacker drops his shoulder and hits Nate low. There's a wet, sickening crunch, and Nate wilts, letting the football drop from his hands.

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]AHH!!![/i][/color]

nodes.text: The linebacker scoops it up and races upfield, carrying the ball all the way to the end zone. The Warriors score a touchdown!
The clock runs out. An air horn blast signals the end of the game!
Owen hesitates!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Uh...
The linebacker drops his shoulder and hits Nate low. There's a wet, sickening crunch, and Nate wilts, letting the football drop from his hands.
The linebacker scoops it up and races upfield, carrying the ball all the way to the end zone. The Warriors score a touchdown!
The clock runs out. An air horn blast signals the end of the game!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Come on, Nate. This is our chance. I can keep the defense off you long enough for you to make a big play.
Nate steps up to Owen, getting close. His eyes drift to the stands, to the crowd looking on with silent, hushed anticipation.
Nate thumps Owen on the chest.

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: Okay, New Guy. But you better not screw this up.
Nate and the offensive line break from their huddle and take position at the line of scrimmage.

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: `Blue 22... Blue 22...`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]Blue 22... Blue 22...[/i][/color]

nodes.text: The ball is hiked, and the lines slam together. Nate drops into the pocket, scanning downfield for an open receiver. A linebacker steamrolls the left tackle, cutting toward Nate!
Owen pivots and moves to block him. The linebacker leaps toward Nate and at the very last second Owen...

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: You've been on the team for `three days` and almost missed the game! You really think you're a part of this team?
nodes.text_bbcode: You've been on the team for [color=#e23b3b][i]three days[/i][/color] and almost missed the game! You really think you're a part of this team?

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Okay, so I haven't been the best teammate... But I came back. That's what matters.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Besides, how many more tackles do you think you can take?
Nate's hand drifts to his bruised shoulder.
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: You don't like me. I don't like you. In fact, you're nothing to me. But we have exactly two things in common. We both love football, and we both want to win.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: And as much as you might hate it, you can't do this without me.

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: You're not making it easy for us, New Guy. They're up 10-7, and the clock is running out. Our offense is the only thing that's kept it close.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: We're still in the game, aren't we? And the clock is ticking. You throw a touchdown right now, and this game is ours.
Owen, Spencer, and the rest of the Twin Branches Squirrels try, but they just can't seem to stop the San Adino Warriors from moving the ball downfield and into their endzone.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Get your head in the game, Owen!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Me? What about you?

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: What `about` me?
nodes.text_bbcode: What [color=#e23b3b][i]about[/i][/color] me?

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: `Uff!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]Uff![/i][/color]

nodes.text: The San Adino quarterback is clear to toss a short 5-yard pass. Spencer tackles the receiver and storms over to Owen.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: `Maggot!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]Maggot![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: ...Ow, why did I even do that?

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Exactly what I was going to ask you. We need to `start playing well` and `stop the offense`, or we're going to lose this game.
nodes.text_bbcode: Exactly what I was going to ask you. We need to [color=#e23b3b][i]start playing well[/i][/color] and [color=#e23b3b][i]stop the offense[/i][/color], or we're going to lose this game.

nodes.text: The two sides square off at the line of scrimmage.
Owen trips up over his own feet and then gets slammed to the ground by an offensive lineman!
Owen bolts off in the wrong direction. Just as he realizes his mistake, he gets slammed to the ground by an offensive lineman!
Owen zips through the hole. The quarterback scrambles away and falls to his knees... For a loss of ten yards!
The crowd cheers!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Yeah! `...YEAH!`
nodes.text_bbcode: Yeah! [color=#e23b3b][i]...YEAH![/i][/color]

nodes.text: Spencer gives Owen a high five.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Great stop, Owen! Now all we need to do is `keep playing well` and `stop the offense`, and we should be in good shape!
nodes.text_bbcode: Great stop, Owen! Now all we need to do is [color=#e23b3b][i]keep playing well[/i][/color] and [color=#e23b3b][i]stop the offense[/i][/color], and we should be in good shape!

nodes.text: Owen bolts off in the wrong direction. Just as he realizes his mistake, he gets slammed to the ground by an offensive lineman!
Owen hesitates and then gets slammed to the ground by an offensive lineman!
Owen cuts around behind the other defenders. Meanwhile, Spencer blasts in from the side, creating a gaping hole in the offensive line.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: There it is! That's my opening!
Owen's eyes shoot wide open! He clutches his stomach.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Oooh... That was something funny I ate.
A San Adino lineman runs over, gags, and then scowls. The offensive lineman slams Owen to the turf!
Owen trips up over his own feet and then gets slammed to the ground by an offensive lineman!
Owen hesitates and then gets slammed to the ground by an offensive lineman!
Owen does an impressive backflip and then gets slammed to the ground by an offensive lineman!
Owen hesitates and then gets slammed to the ground by an offensive lineman!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: You're thinking we should get to their quarterback?

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Just like The Combine. Backpedal, cut right, and then turn on the juice. I'll clear a path for you.
The offensive and defensive lines square off. The quarterback takes the snap and drops back. Immediately, Owen...

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: `Rarrr!!!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]Rarrr!!![/i][/color]

nodes.text: Owen charges forward! The terrified receiver scurries out of bounds! The crowd leaps to its feet and cheers!

nodes.speaker: Zach
nodes.text: Boom! That's what I'm talking about, baby!

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: Whoa... Was that the New Guy?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: His `name` is Owen, and I told you we needed him!
nodes.text_bbcode: His [color=#3b78e2][i]name[/i][/color] is Owen, and I told you we needed him!

nodes.text: As the San Adino quarterback jogs out onto the field, Spencer slaps Owen on the back.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Nice stop!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: What? No 'Maggot'?

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Nah. You don't need any more motivation. In fact, I think you might be motivating me! And it's a good thing too...

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: It's our job to keep them from marching down the field. If we let the Warriors' offense walk all over us, they're going to win the game.
Owen moves to stop the receiver, but his feet slide out awkwardly from beneath him! He slams down flat on the ground!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]AAH!!![/i][/color]

nodes.text: The receiver deftly leaps over his prone body, gaining another fifteen yards before Spencer finally brings him down.
Spencer walks over, helps Owen up, and slaps his helmet.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Remember your training, maggot! There's no room for mistakes out here. You need to think `fast!` Got it?
nodes.text_bbcode: Remember your training, maggot! There's no room for mistakes out here. You need to think [color=#e23b3b][i]fast![/i][/color] Got it?

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Yeah... It won't happen again.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: It better not. It's our job to keep them from marching down the field. If we let the Warriors' offense walk all over us, they're going to win the game.
Owen hesitates. He starts to move, and his feet slide out awkwardly from beneath him! He slams down flat on the ground!
Owen and the rest of the kicking team take to the field. The ball is kicked!
Owen pushes through the receiving team, heads toward the kickoff returner, and...

nodes.speaker: Jacob
nodes.text: Trust you? But you bailed, and now you're not even giving us an explanation why!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Trust is earned, or trust gets burned! Booyah!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Right, I know that, but...
The referees walk out onto the field, calling out the team captains for the coin toss. Nate walks to them. The coin's flipped!

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: Heads!
It's tails, and the San Adino Warriors elect to receive the kickoff first.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Listen, guys, there's no more time. You need to decide. Can I play or not?
The team mumbles among itself, coming to an agreement, and then Jacob turns back to Owen.

nodes.speaker: Jacob
nodes.text: Yeah. Like it or not, we really do need you out there.
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: You're down a linebacker, and you'll need a solid defense to stop the Warriors' offense. And I promise you, I am going to bring it out there!
The football players murmur among themselves and then turn back to Owen!

nodes.speaker: Jacob
nodes.text: Okay then, it's decided. Suit up!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Welcome back, maggot!
The referees walk out onto the field, calling out the team captains for the coin toss. Nate walks to them. The coin's flipped!

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: `Heads!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]Heads![/i][/color]

nodes.text: It's tails, and the San Adino Warriors elect to receive the kickoff first.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: How are you feeling?

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: ...Honestly? Like a huge weight's been lifted off my chest.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: I'll always feel guilty for what happened. I'll never forget it.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: But I think I'm ready to start moving on.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: You mean...

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Let's get back to Twin Branches. I've got a game to win.
Ben pulls the car to the curb, and Owen and $ZOE leap out, racing across the campus.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: We need to hurry! The game is going to start any second now!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Oh no! The squad is going to kill me for being so late!
They race through the gate and down to the field.
$ZOE leans in, pecks Owen on the cheek, and then dashes over to the wobbly cheerleader pyramid. From where he stands, Owen can hear Maria yell.

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: $ZOE! There you are! Where have you been?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I went to get Owen...

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: The guy who flaked on the team?!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: It isn't like that... You'll see...
Meanwhile, Owen sighs and steps over to where the football team has assembled along the sidelines.

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: You've got a lot of nerve showing up this late, New Guy. You left the team hanging out to dry.
Nate leans in and whispers.

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: Plus, did you forget what I have over you? Do you really want $ZOE finding out what you did?

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: She already knows, Nate.

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: She what?

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: You heard me.
Owen shoulders by Nate and joins the rest of the team.

nodes.speaker: Jacob
nodes.text: What happened, Owen?

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Yeah, where were you, maggot?

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: I owe you all an explanation, I know that, but this game is about to start. And that means...

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: It was you, wasn't it? You're the one who's been harassing me!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Look, I get it. You're mad about what I did to your brother. And that's fine. You should be.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: But smashing my mailbox? Trashing my car? `Breaking into my house?`
nodes.text_bbcode: But smashing my mailbox? Trashing my car? [color=#e23b3b][i]Breaking into my house?[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: That is not okay. And it stops now.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: If I ever see you around me again... I'm calling the cops. You understand?

nodes.speaker: Boy
nodes.text: Y... Yeah. I do.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Good.
Owen turns away, and the kid scrambles upstairs.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: That was... Harsh...

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: He broke into my house and scared my grandmother, $ZOE. There's some lines you don't cross.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: ...I understand.
The two walk through the crisp evening air towards the car.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: You're the one who's been harassing me, aren't you?

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: ...It's okay. I'm not mad. I just... Want to talk.

nodes.speaker: Boy
nodes.text: Well... I don't want to talk to you! You broke my brother's leg! You ruined his chances to be a football star!

nodes.speaker: Boy
nodes.text: I hate you!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: ...I understand. If I were in your place, I'd hate me too. But your brother doesn't anymore. Which makes him the biggest man out of all of us.

nodes.speaker: Boy
nodes.text: He... He doesn't hate you?

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: No. I just came to talk to him... To apologize for what I did. And I'm going to follow his lead and forgive you for what you've done to me. Breaking my mailbox... Trashing my car... Scaring my grandmother...

nodes.speaker: Boy
nodes.text: I... I scared your grandmother?

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Yeah. And I know you didn't mean to. I know you've just got a lot of anger and confusion, and you're taking it out on me.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: So let's make a deal. I won't tell anyone about what you did... And you stop harassing me. Deal?

nodes.speaker: Boy
nodes.text: ...Yeah. Okay. Deal.
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Good.
Owen turns to walk away. The boy calls out after him...

nodes.speaker: Boy
nodes.text: ...Thank you... For coming.

nodes.speaker: Boy
nodes.text: The fact that you never came... That was the worst part.
The boy runs off and vanishes upstairs into the apartment. Owen watches him go, then joins $ZOE in walking to the car.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: I'm sorry for what I did. I shouldn't have made that late hit. And I'll regret it every day for the rest of my life.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: I just... I just wanted you to know that.
Ken says nothing, just turns away. Owen turns to $ZOE, and she gently rests her hand on his shoulder. The two of them get up to leave...

nodes.speaker: Ken
nodes.text: ...Wait.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: What is it?

nodes.speaker: Ken
nodes.text: ...When I first got out of the hospital, I was mad. No. Not mad. I was furious. All I could think about was how bad I wanted to get back at you. I `hated` you. I dreamed about hurting you.
nodes.text_bbcode: ...When I first got out of the hospital, I was mad. No. Not mad. I was furious. All I could think about was how bad I wanted to get back at you. I [color=#e23b3b][i]hated[/i][/color] you. I dreamed about hurting you.

nodes.speaker: Ken
nodes.text: But then I started physical therapy. I started focusing all my efforts on trying to walk again. There are little improvements every day, but I had to let go of all that hate to concentrate on getting better.

nodes.speaker: Ken
nodes.text: And then I learned about your dad. About the way he pushed you. About the pressure you were under. And I guess... I guess I kind of understood.

nodes.speaker: Ken
nodes.text: I don't forgive you. I don't know if I'll ever forgive you.

nodes.speaker: Ken
nodes.text: ...But I don't hate you anymore. And you deserve to know that.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: ...Thank you.

nodes.speaker: Ken
nodes.text: So, you go to a new school, huh? You still playing football?

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: I don't know... I... I don't think I should.

nodes.speaker: Ken
nodes.text: Because of me?

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Because of what I did.

nodes.speaker: Ken
nodes.text: You listen to me... That's crazy talk.

nodes.speaker: Ken
nodes.text: Now I'm never going to play again. And I'm living with that. It tears me apart inside not to be able to run down that field, to feel that rush, to hear that crowd.

nodes.speaker: Ken
nodes.text: You've still got two good legs. You can still hit. You can still run. And it sounds like you've figured out where your head's at.

nodes.speaker: Ken
nodes.text: If you quit now, well, it's kind of like I'm ruining the game for you... And I'm done dreaming about revenge. I can't afford to think like that.

nodes.speaker: Ken
nodes.text: If you want to do right by me... Go out there and play.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: You mean that?

nodes.speaker: Ken
nodes.text: Yeah. I really do.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Thank you.
Owen and $ZOE step outside. As they walk away, a rickety, old car rumbles up to the curb. Sitting behind the wheel is a boy in his early teens...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Isn't he a little young to be driving?
The boy hops out of the car. He starts to head up to the apartments when he spots $ZOE and Owen...

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Wait a minute... I recognize that car...

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: That's the car that I saw driving off the night my mailbox got smashed... That means this kid's the one who's been harassing me! He must be Ken's little brother!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Hey! Kid!

nodes.speaker: Boy
nodes.text: Wh... What?
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: I realized that not facing you... Not owning up to what I'd done... It was weak and cowardly. And it wasn't fair to you.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: What I did was terrible... And running from it just made it worse.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: I don't deserve your forgiveness... But you still deserve my apology.

nodes.speaker: Ken
nodes.text: Oh, have you now?

nodes.speaker: Ken
nodes.text: I bet that would make you feel a `lot` better, wouldn't it? If I said 'Oh, I forgive you,' and you could just `walk` out of here into the rest of your life?
nodes.text_bbcode: I bet that would make you feel a [color=#e23b3b][i]lot[/i][/color] better, wouldn't it? If I said 'Oh, I forgive you,' and you could just [color=#e23b3b][i]walk[/i][/color] out of here into the rest of your life?

nodes.speaker: Ken
nodes.text: Meanwhile, I'd still be here... In this chair.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: ...You're right. I don't deserve your forgiveness...

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: But you still deserve my apology.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: I looked up where Ken lived a while ago. I've come to this spot a dozen times now... To try to talk to him. To apologize for what I did.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: But I never made it to the door.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Why not?

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: I can't face him. I can't face what I did.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Owen... You can do this. I'll go with you. I'll be by your side the whole time.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: You would do that?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Of course.
The two sit there for a moment... Then Owen stands up.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Are you ready to go in?

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: As ready as I'll ever be.
$ZOE takes Owen's hand. The two walk up the stairs of the apartment complex. They knock on the door, and it swings open, revealing a young man in a wheelchair...

nodes.speaker: Ken
nodes.text: ...You.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Yeah. Me.
The two guys stare at each other for a moment...

nodes.speaker: Ken
nodes.text: Well? Come on in.
Owen walks in. $ZOE hesitates for just one moment, then follows after...
You are now playing as Owen.
Ken rolls up to a table. Owen takes a seat opposite him, and $ZOE stands by Owen's side.

nodes.speaker: Ken
nodes.text: I gotta say... I never thought I'd see you on my doorstep, Owen.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: That makes two of us.

nodes.speaker: Ken
nodes.text: So what exactly do you want?

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: I came here to...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: You've changed, Owen. You hate who you used to be. You hate what you did.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: You say that like it's a good thing.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: It `is.` It means that you're never going to do something like that again! Right?
nodes.text_bbcode: It [color=#3b78e2][i]is.[/i][/color] It means that you're never going to do something like that again! Right?

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Right.
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: What happened was terrible... But that's not you. Not anymore. You have to accept that you've changed.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: You're... You're right, $ZOE.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Move on? $ZOE, Ken may never walk again. How can I move on when he's still stuck in that wheelchair?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Okay, so maybe that's not the right way to look at it.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: But torturing yourself over what you did isn't the answer.
Owen lunges forward, grabbing the QB by the waist and driving him to the ground in a hard, late tackle.

nodes.speaker: Ken
nodes.text: Hkkk!
The two guys slam into the ground. There's a loud crunch, like twigs snapping.
The crowd gasps. The ref tosses a yellow flag into the air. A burst of lightning flashes overhead.

nodes.speaker: Fan
nodes.text: `KEN!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]KEN![/i][/color]

nodes.text: Owen looks into the quarterback's face, frozen in a pained grimace...

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Are... Are you okay?
Then there is only silence.
You are now playing as $ZOE.
Owen turns away from $ZOE.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: I just wanted to rough him up a little... Enough to take him out of the game.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: But he landed just wrong. The tackle pulled his leg back under him and shattered his femur. It put him in a wheelchair. They say they don't know if he'll ever walk again.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Oh... Owen...

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: The second I got up... I realized what I had done... But it was too late.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: We won the game, but... I just couldn't deal with it. All I could think about was that hit... That snapping sound... That look on his face.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: So I ran. My grandmother was willing to take me in, so I went to stay with her.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: And your dad?

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: He hated me for quitting the team. He said if I wasn't going to play, I was no son of his.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: That's terrible...

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: I tried to run from what happened...

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: But I couldn't escape it. Someone keeps harassing me. Nate found out the truth. And now you know too.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: But it's not your fault, Owen! Your father, he... He pressured you...

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: No. It was `my` fault. I knew what I was doing, and I did it anyway!
nodes.text_bbcode: No. It was [color=#e23b3b][i]my[/i][/color] fault. I knew what I was doing, and I did it anyway!

nodes.text: Owen puts on his helmet and steps out onto the field.
Thunder rolls overhead. The players line up. The rain pours down, a thick torrential curtain, sparkling in the hot floodlights.
Owen looks out at the stands, hears the roar of the crowd, and scans the sea of expectant faces...

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: I don't have a choice... We `have` to win!
nodes.text_bbcode: I don't have a choice... We [color=#e23b3b][i]have[/i][/color] to win!

nodes.text: The ball is hiked! The other team's QB hurls it, but the pass is batted down!

nodes.speaker: Ken
nodes.text: Come on!
Owen keeps charging forward even though the play is over... Even though the other team's QB has stopped playing... Even though he feels sick to his stomach...
He knows he has no choice.

nodes.speaker: Coach Harris
nodes.text: Excuse me?
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: ...I don't know. It just... Doesn't seem right...
Owen's father slaps the back of his helmet!

nodes.speaker: Coach Harris
nodes.text: Stop thinking about what's right, and start thinking about winning!

nodes.speaker: Coach Harris
nodes.text: That's the `only thing` that matters! If we lose this game, we lose everything! You understand?
nodes.text_bbcode: That's the [color=#e23b3b][i]only thing[/i][/color] that matters! If we lose this game, we lose everything! You understand?

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Yeah... I do.

nodes.speaker: Coach Harris
nodes.text: Now get out there!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: I'll do whatever it takes.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Owen...

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: It was the worst decision I ever made... And I made it so easily, without even a moment of hesitation.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: What happened next?

nodes.speaker: Coach Harris
nodes.text: Now get out there and play to win!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Yeah!
The team snaps on their helmets and rushes out, storming into the pouring rain. As Owen goes, Coach Harris stops him for just one second...

nodes.speaker: Coach Harris
nodes.text: I'm counting on you...

nodes.speaker: Coach Harris
nodes.text: `Son.`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]Son.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Wait... The coach was `your dad?`
nodes.text_bbcode: Wait... The coach was [color=#3b78e2][i]your dad?[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Yeah. He's a former pro player who blew out a knee and had to quit. He lives, breathes, and sleeps football.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: He moved our family to Pinecrest so he could take the coaching job. That's why it was so important to him...

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: For him, if we lost, it wouldn't have been just about the game. He would have lost his reputation, his job, maybe even our house.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: That's why... That's why we had to win.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: What happened next?

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: ...We played to win.
Owen slumps against a bench, panting. Rain pours down on him, pattering against his helmet. His heart pounds in his chest.
He looks up at the scoreboard... Start of the fourth quarter...

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: We can do this... I know we can...

nodes.speaker: Coach Harris
nodes.text: Not if we let that QB of theirs get off another long scramble. That boy Ken is a speed demon, and our defense is running on fumes!
Their quarterback turns and scowls in Owen's direction...
Owen's father leans in and talks in a low, secretive voice...

nodes.speaker: Coach Harris
nodes.text: Listen to me. You `cannot` let him score another touchdown.
nodes.text_bbcode: Listen to me. You [color=#e23b3b][i]cannot[/i][/color] let him score another touchdown.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: What are you saying?

nodes.speaker: Coach Harris
nodes.text: I think you know what I'm saying, boy. I want you to take him out of the game `any way you can.` Even if it means you drawing a flag from the refs. Take him out, and we win.
nodes.text_bbcode: I think you know what I'm saying, boy. I want you to take him out of the game [color=#e23b3b][i]any way you can.[/i][/color] Even if it means you drawing a flag from the refs. Take him out, and we win.

nodes.speaker: Coach Harris
nodes.text: Play your best? Play your `best?!`
nodes.text_bbcode: Play your best? Play your [color=#e23b3b][i]best?![/i][/color]

nodes.text: Coach Harris grabs Owen by the uniform and shoves him back against the locker!

nodes.speaker: Coach Harris
nodes.text: I don't care about your best! I care about `winning!`
nodes.text_bbcode: I don't care about your best! I care about [color=#e23b3b][i]winning![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Coach Harris
nodes.text: This isn't baby's first checkers where everyone's a winner! This is football! This is `real!`
nodes.text_bbcode: This isn't baby's first checkers where everyone's a winner! This is football! This is [color=#e23b3b][i]real![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Coach Harris
nodes.text: If you care about anything but winning, I don't even want you on my field! You understand?

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: ...Yes, sir.

nodes.speaker: Coach Harris
nodes.text: Now what are you gonna do?

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: I'm gonna win!

nodes.speaker: Coach Harris
nodes.text: Yeah, you are!
Owen turns back to the room and chants...

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: We're gonna win!
And the team shouts back... `'We're gonna win!'`
nodes.text_bbcode: And the team shouts back... [b]'We're gonna win!'[/b]

nodes.speaker: Coach Harris
nodes.text: That's right you are!
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: We're gonna go out there, and we're gonna run and fight and bleed until there's nothing left of the other team!
The rest of the room shouts... `'Yeah we are!'`
nodes.text_bbcode: The rest of the room shouts... [b]'Yeah we are!'[/b]

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: We're not just gonna beat 'em... We're gonna shame 'em. We're gonna crush 'em. We're gonna destroy 'em.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: For the rest of their lives, they're going to look back on tonight with shame and regret... And they'll `never` forget our faces!
nodes.text_bbcode: For the rest of their lives, they're going to look back on tonight with shame and regret... And they'll [color=#e23b3b][i]never[/i][/color] forget our faces!

nodes.text: The team shouts again, and now it's a roar... `No they won't!'`
nodes.text_bbcode: The team shouts again, and now it's a roar... [b]No they won't!'[/b]

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: We're the Pinecrest Bobcats... And `we don't lose!`
nodes.text_bbcode: We're the Pinecrest Bobcats... And [color=#e23b3b][i]we don't lose![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Coach Harris
nodes.text: That's the spirit!

nodes.speaker: Jake
nodes.text: That guy's the best! Never met a better linebacker. He won a lot of games for us.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: So you actually all like Owen. That... Is... Great...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Do you know where we could find him?

nodes.speaker: Dan
nodes.text: Sorry... He disappeared a few months back...

nodes.speaker: Dan
nodes.text: No word to anyone, just shut off his phone and vanished.

nodes.speaker: Jake
nodes.text: But it sounds like you guys know him.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: He showed up at our school a week ago... You're right, he's... He's a great guy.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: But now he disappeared again. We were hoping you might know where we could find him.

nodes.speaker: Dan
nodes.text: Sorry, like I said... He took off and no one ever heard from him again.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Oh...
The football players start to head back to the field, but Jake hangs back.

nodes.speaker: Jake
nodes.text: There is one thing you should know. When Owen disappeared... No one knows for sure why he left, but I always thought... Well, it was right after the biggest game of the season.

nodes.speaker: Jake
nodes.text: There was... An accident. Owen was involved. He really blamed himself. He didn't talk about it much, but he wasn't the same after. A couple weeks later, he was gone.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: An accident? What kind of accident?

nodes.speaker: Jake
nodes.text: It was bad. The other guy... He was hurt real bad.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: ...Do you know where we can find this guy?
A short drive later, Ben and $ZOE arrive at an apartment complex.
Outside is Owen, sitting on the curb with his head in his hands.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I can't believe we found him.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: What are you going to say?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I'm not sure... But I think I should go alone.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I'll be waiting in the car.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Good luck.
$ZOE walks up to Owen. He glances at her when she gets closer.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: $ZOE. How did you find me?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Well, you didn't exactly make it easy... But I had some help. Are you okay?

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Not really. Haven't been for a while.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: I thought I could start over. I thought I could forget what happened... But you can't escape your past.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: You mean what happened in your last football game?

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: How did you...?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I went to your old school, Owen. I talked to your old teammates.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: What?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I was worried about you!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: So now you know. You probably think I'm a monster.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Of course not! It was an accident. It wasn't your fault. You can't blame yourself.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Accidents like this happen.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: You don't understand. You keep calling it an accident!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Then tell me! Help me understand! What happened here?

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: ...It all went down three months ago.
You are now playing as Owen.

Three months ago... Owen sits in a locker room at Pinecrest High. The rest of the team sits around him. Their faces are streaked with sweat and mud. They look like they've just come from a battlefield.
The door to the room flies open! A stocky man storms in...

nodes.speaker: Coach Harris
nodes.text: What is `wrong` with you boys?!
nodes.text_bbcode: What is [color=#e23b3b][i]wrong[/i][/color] with you boys?!

nodes.speaker: Coach Harris
nodes.text: 24-0 at halftime? They're `killing` us out there! This isn't a game... It's a massacre!
nodes.text_bbcode: 24-0 at halftime? They're [color=#e23b3b][i]killing[/i][/color] us out there! This isn't a game... It's a massacre!

nodes.text: Owen glances at the bruised and weary faces of his teammates. No one will meet Coach Harris's eyes.

nodes.speaker: Coach Harris
nodes.text: Now you pathetic sacks of crap listen to me. This is our one shot at the playoffs. If we don't win this game, we are out. You understand me? `Out!`
nodes.text_bbcode: Now you pathetic sacks of crap listen to me. This is our one shot at the playoffs. If we don't win this game, we are out. You understand me? [color=#e23b3b][i]Out![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Jake
nodes.text: They're just... They're too good, Coach! We can't break through!
Coach Harris snarls and hurls a water bottle at Jake!

nodes.speaker: Coach Harris
nodes.text: You're as weak as you are stupid, boy! If you're gonna talk like a quitter, then get out of my locker room!

nodes.speaker: Coach Harris
nodes.text: As for the rest of you... It's not too late to turn this around. It's not too late to win this thing. But I need you to stop being scared little boys...

nodes.speaker: Coach Harris
nodes.text: And I need you to become `men.` Savage, ruthless, terrifying men. You understand me?
nodes.text_bbcode: And I need you to become [color=#e23b3b][i]men.[/i][/color] Savage, ruthless, terrifying men. You understand me?

nodes.text: The room shouts back as one... `'Yes sir!'` Coach Harris looks right at Owen...
nodes.text_bbcode: The room shouts back as one... [b]'Yes sir!'[/b] Coach Harris looks right at Owen...

nodes.speaker: Coach Harris
nodes.text: You're the Captain of this team, boy. What are you gonna do?

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: I'm gonna go out there and...

nodes.prompt: I'm gonna go out there and...

menu.title: Make your choice!
menu.text: I'm gonna go out there and...

nodes.speaker: Dan
nodes.text: That doesn't sound like Owen.

nodes.speaker: Jake
nodes.text: Whatever the problem is, I'm sure we can help you straighten it out. Owen is a solid guy.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: You... Don't hate Owen?

nodes.speaker: Jake
nodes.text: Hate him? Are you crazy?

nodes.speaker: Jake
nodes.text: How much does he owe you? We can cover it.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: You... Would do that for Owen?

nodes.speaker: Jake
nodes.text: Of course. He'd do the same for me. How much is it?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Um, forget about the money. It isn't really important.

nodes.speaker: Jake
nodes.text: I insist!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: No, really... It's not a big deal.

nodes.speaker: Jake
nodes.text: Obviously it was important enough for you to come here looking for him. Just tell me how much. I'm not letting you leave until I settle this for Owen.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Um. Okay. Two dollars.

nodes.speaker: Jake
nodes.text: You're tracking him down for two dollars?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Hey, a dollar's a dollar! I said you could forget it.

nodes.speaker: Jake
nodes.text: No way!
Jake digs into his pocket and hands $ZOE two dollars.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Thanks...

nodes.speaker: Jake
nodes.text: No problem. I owe Owen a hundred times that.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: So you don't... Hate him?

nodes.speaker: Jake
nodes.text: Hate him? Are you crazy?

nodes.speaker: Dan
nodes.text: Well, any friend of Owen's is a friend of ours. I'm Dan.
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: You're friends with Owen too?

nodes.speaker: Dan
nodes.text: Of course!

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Let me see... This one right here has a bobcat on the cover. Take a look.
$ZOE takes the yearbook and flips through the pages...
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: There he is! Owen Harris.
$ZOE looks at the cover.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Pinecrest High...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: That's two hours away.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Then we better get going.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: $ZOE... Are you sure? We might not even make it back in time for the game... And if we don't...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Then Paige is going to make sure everyone knows that I didn't even bother showing up.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Not to mention that the squad isn't going to appreciate being down a cheerleader.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: ...Owen is more important. If there's even a chance that he's in trouble...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Then I'm going to find him.
As Ben drives, $ZOE flips through the Pinecrest yearbook...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I don't believe it.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: What is it?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: It's Owen. He was on the Pinecrest football team.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I thought he said he didn't really play.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: That's what he said... But he's in the team picture.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Why would he lie?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I don't know... But maybe we can get some answers at Pinecrest.
A long drive later... $ZOE and Ben arrive at Pinecrest High. School is out for the day, and the parking lot is empty except for a few cars.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Is something wrong?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: What was Owen hiding here? What else did he lie about? I'm scared, Ben. I'm scared I'm about to find out something terrible.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Hey, whatever it is... I'm in this with you. It'll be better to know the truth.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Maybe Owen did something awful. Maybe all the people here hate him. Maybe he's on the run. No matter what, it's better to know.
$ZOE and Ben wander towards the football field, where a group of players are playing a friendly game.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Owen was on the team... I bet one of these guys will know him.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Hey! Excuse me!
The guys turn to Ben.

nodes.speaker: Dan
nodes.text: Who are you?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I'm $ZOE, and this is Ben.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: We were wondering if you could help us out.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: We're looking for someone who went to school here... A guy named Owen Harris. Do you know him?

nodes.speaker: Jake
nodes.text: Owen? Yeah, we know that guy. What do you want with him?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: What if these guys don't like Owen? Maybe I shouldn't tell them he's our friend...

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: Well, I think you're wasting your time... But be careful, okay?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Thanks, Nate.
As $ZOE walks down the hall after lunch, she hears...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Hey! $ZOE! Wait up!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Ben?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: If you're going to track down Owen, you shouldn't do it alone. It might get hard. And when times get hard, Ben is there!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: When did you become a superhero?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Sorry. Got carried away. But, yeah. I'm coming with you.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: You would do that for me?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: $ZOE, you're the sweetest person I've ever met. And you've never skipped a day of school in your life.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: On the other hand, I've kind of made a habit of it. I would be a monster if I let you do something like this alone.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Now, where should we start? Sneak off campus and...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I... I don't know. I'm not really sure where to start looking...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Maybe you were onto something with asking Nate what he and Owen were talking about. I kind of got the feeling that Nate didn't want to talk about it.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: The book you saw him holding... Did it have a squirrel on it?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: You know, I don't think it did...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Every playbook from Twin Branches has the school logo and the squirrel on it. Maybe it was something from another school?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Oh! Maybe it was from Owen's old school?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Ogden High? But that doesn't make sense... Ogden doesn't even have a football team!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: You don't think... He lied about where he transferred from...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: ...I think it's possible, yeah. But how do we figure out what school he `really` came from?
nodes.text_bbcode: ...I think it's possible, yeah. But how do we figure out what school he [color=#e23b3b][i]really[/i][/color] came from?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Nick and Autumn are always studying yearbooks from other schools! I bet they can help us figure it out!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Let's go!
$ZOE and Ben rush to the library, where the Yearbook Club meets.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Hey, Nick. I was wondering if we could take a look at the yearbooks you've collected from the other schools in the state.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Sure. Anything in particular you're looking for?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: We're trying to find Owen, and we think where he is might have something to do with his past. If we could find his old school, it'd really help!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Last night, Nate showed Owen a folder that had a mascot on it. I think that might be a good place to start. The mascot was a...

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: Really? Do you know where he lives?

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: Do you have his number?

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: Do you even know his last name?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: No... I guess I don't... Is that weird?

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: Yeah, it's really weird! That guy is a closed book. He doesn't let any information about his life slip.

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: Don't you think that's weird?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I guess it is a little strange... But that's all the more reason why we need to figure out why he's missing!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I may not know everything about him, but I can't shake the feeling that he's a good guy.
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: But you're right... There is something strange about how he disappeared... And I'm going to figure out what happened.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Just wait 'til you see the party I'm throwing tonight. If you're brave enough to show up.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: No one's even going to remember `your` party.
nodes.text_bbcode: No one's even going to remember [color=#3b78e2][i]your[/i][/color] party.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Come on, Paige, you don't have to be such a brat about this.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: If little Miss Kittens and Rainbows didn't want a fight, she shouldn't have started one!
Paige turns and storms off.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Don't let her get to you.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I won't.
In the cafeteria, $ZOE and Sam sit down next to Ben and the football players.

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: $ZOE! I've been looking for you. Have you seen Owen?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: No... I haven't seen him since the party yesterday.

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: The football team met this morning to go over the playbook one last time. Owen didn't show.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: He knows we're counting on him for the game.

nodes.speaker: Jacob
nodes.text: Yeah, if he's not there, we've got no chance!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: We spent all morning looking for him, but no one can reach him... It's like he's disappeared!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Something is wrong, I can feel it.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Are you sure? I can't say I'm surprised. I warned you about getting involved with this guy.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: She has a point. How do you know he didn't just decide to ditch class today?

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: I never trusted that guy.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Owen wouldn't do that... He knows he has to be here for the game.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Maybe he doesn't care about the game, and I hate to say this, but maybe he doesn't care about you either.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I don't believe that. Wherever he is, something is `wrong.`
nodes.text_bbcode: I don't believe that. Wherever he is, something is [color=#3b78e2][i]wrong.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Maybe he broke his arm trying to rescue a kitten from a tree! Maybe he's recovering from running into a burning building to save a baby!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Um... $ZOE, things like that don't actually happen...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Okay, well, maybe he's just confused, or maybe he's in trouble. Whatever it is, I'm going to figure it out.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Nate, weren't you talking to him at the party last night?

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: Huh? Oh, yeah. I did run into him.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: What were you talking to him about? I saw you showing him something...

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: That? That was just the playbook. I thought he should take it with him, do some reading after the party.

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: Maybe he couldn't take the pressure. I hope he's not getting cold feet.

nodes.speaker: Jacob
nodes.text: He wouldn't do that to us. He knows how much is riding on this game!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I'm sure he'll be there!

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: Oh really? You only met him a few days ago. How much do you really know about him?

options.label: I've got a good feeling about him.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: You said it yourself, it was a good party...

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Let me explain it to you, sweetie... You see, you got to make your play... And now it's my turn.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I've done more than just throw a party. I've worked day and night this week getting ready for the game tonight.
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Banners, posters, decorations... Everyone is going to see all of that hard work.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Well, I guess that `might` factor in. Hard work was never really my strong suit...
nodes.text_bbcode: Well, I guess that [color=#3b78e2][i]might[/i][/color] factor in. Hard work was never really my strong suit...

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: But do you really believe that people will be thinking about posters when they decide? It's going to come down to parties.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: And no one beats one of my parties.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Oh, you're so cute when you're confused!
You are now playing as $ZOE.
As $ZOE and Sam walk to lunch, $ZOE spots people from the party the night before...

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: Nice party last night, $ZOE.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Thanks, Nicole!

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Great party last night, $ZOE!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Yeah, I didn't think you had it in you, but that party was awesome.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Thanks... I think...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Looks like the party was a success.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Yeah... People have been congratulating me all day!
Just then, Paige storms up to $ZOE and Sam...

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: So, I heard your little party went pretty well. I bet now you think you actually have a shot at winning this thing.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I've got more than a shot!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Oh, $ZOE... Poor, sweet, sweet $ZOE. You threw `one` good party. I'll give you that. But do you really think that'll be enough?
nodes.text_bbcode: Oh, $ZOE... Poor, sweet, sweet $ZOE. You threw [color=#3b78e2][i]one[/i][/color] good party. I'll give you that. But do you really think that'll be enough?

nodes.text: With just 30 seconds left in the game, Owen and Spencer return to the sidelines, passing Nate and the offense as they jog onto the field.
Nate and the offense take position. Nate calls the play, takes the hike...
And a linebacker runs over the right tackle and sacks Nate for a loss of ten yards! Nate lurches unsteadily to his feet.

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: `Uhhhh...`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]Uhhhh...[/i][/color]

nodes.text: At the sidelines, Jacob shakes his head.

nodes.speaker: Jacob
nodes.text: Oh man, Nate can't take any more hits like that one.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Put me in. I'll protect him.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Did I hear that right? You want to protect `Nate?`
nodes.text_bbcode: Did I hear that right? You want to protect [color=#e23b3b][i]Nate?[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: I want to win. The offensive line is getting creamed out there, and I'm big enough stop those guys.

nodes.speaker: Jacob
nodes.text: Owen...

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: I can do it. Just trust me.

nodes.speaker: Jacob
nodes.text: Fine. Get out there.
Owen jogs out to the field, taking over the right tackle position.

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: Hey, what are you doing out here, New Guy?

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Covering you. You just be ready to throw the ball.

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: No. I know what this is. You're here so you can take credit for my big win.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: If we were `winning`, I wouldn't even be standing here. But I am here. And that's because...
nodes.text_bbcode: If we were [color=#e23b3b][i]winning[/i][/color], I wouldn't even be standing here. But I am here. And that's because...

nodes.text: He drops back a few yards, and then...
The two sides square off at the line of scrimmage.
Nate and the offensive line break from their huddle and take position at the line of scrimmage.

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: `Blue 22... Blue 22...`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]Blue 22... Blue 22...[/i][/color]

nodes.text: The ball is hiked, and the lines slam together. Nate drops into the pocket, scanning downfield for an open receiver. A linebacker steamrolls the left tackle, cutting toward Nate!
Owen pivots and moves to block him. The linebacker leaps toward Nate and at the very last second Owen...

Episode One
The First Day
Welcome to `Surviving High School!` You'll be playing as a transfer student named Owen on his first day at Twin Branches High!
Well, here I am... Starting fresh at a new school.
Hi there. I haven't seen you here before. Are you lost?
Make your choice!
Yeah, I'm new here.|Who wants to know?|I was lost... Until I found you.
What do you say?
My name's Owen.
I'm $ZOE! Nice to meet you, Owen!
Score Up!
Nice to meet you too.
Is everyone around here as friendly as you?
Well... I guess I `do` have a reputation for being nice.
`That` I can believe.
Follow me. I'll show you around.
Owen and $ZOE step into the school's hallway...
So... Why did you transfer here, anyway?
A memory flashes... Pouring rain... The smell of grass... The roar of a crowd...
I came here for a chance to start over.
...Oh. Well, let me know if you need any help. I transferred here when I was a sophomore, so I know what it's like.
Hey, $ZOE! Who's the new guy?
Hi Emily. This is Owen. He just transferred here.
You picked a good day to start. There's a pep rally after lunch to get everyone excited for the game on Friday!
$ZOE, are you ready? I heard the cheerleaders were practicing a new routine.
You're a cheerleader, $ZOE? I guess I should have known.
Oh? And what's `that` supposed to mean?
I'm looking forward to hearing this...
I just mean it makes sense! Cheerleaders are...
Make your choice!
Nice.|Outgoing.
Cheerleaders are...
Score Up!
I mean, you went out of your way to welcome a total stranger to the school.
That's the kind of confidence you get from being in the spotlight.
You know, you've got a point. Before I started cheerleading, I was `incredibly` shy.
And now you don't even get nervous when you're performing at the pep rally in front of the whole school!
Well, it's not `exactly` like that...
Really? I don't think `that's` the stereotype.
And I hate to admit it, but some of the girls on the squad would backstab anyone to be at the top of the pyramid.
Is that what we can look forward to at this pep rally? A cheerleader backstabbing brawl?
Ha ha! Not exactly.
What's this pep rally for, anyway?
The Twin Branches football team is playing in the State Championship game this Friday... Everyone is really excited.
Just then, someone runs into Owen!
`Ooof!`
Owen starts to lose his balance, falling forward...
Hurry!
Grab $ZOE!|Catch yourself!
What do you do?
Owen lurches right into $ZOE! The two of them tumble down to the ground!
`Ouch!`
Oww!
Owen frantically scrambles up! Standing right behind him is a well-dressed guy who reaches down to help $ZOE up. He turns to Owen...
Owen almost falls over but manages to catch himself!
Score Up!
Whoa!
Standing right behind Owen is a well-dressed guy.
Oh hey, you must be the new kid. Sorry about running into you! I didn't see you there!
Really? I'm not exactly easy to miss...
Heh! You've got a sense of humor! I like that!
Hey, Nate. Emily and I are showing Owen around.
Don't you girls have to get to the gym across campus for P.E. in a couple of minutes?
You should get going. I'll give New Kid here the rest of the tour.
Thanks, Nate! You're so sweet! See you around, Owen!
$ZOE and Emily run off.
Hey man, I'm Owen. I just...
Nate cuts Owen off by shoving him against a locker!
Listen here, buddy. I'll be nice because you're new.
This is nice? I'd hate to see mean.
I get that you don't know how things work around here... But you'd better `stay away` from $ZOE.
Make your choice!
Insult him.|Punch him.|Back down.
What do you do?
Score Up!
Oh yeah? Why don't `you` stay away from hair gel? Because honestly it's not a good look for you.
Oh, you think you're real funny...
I think I'm kind of amusing, yeah...
Well, $ZOE's a good girl. I'm just looking out for her. She doesn't need a guy like you in her life.
I'm not sure that's for you to decide.
You just made the wrong enemy.
As Nate storms off, a guy walks over to Owen.
You know, when you think about it, that's kind of a dumb expression. I mean, no one ever says 'You just made the `best` enemy!'
Somehow, I don't think that guy spends a lot of time thinking about word choice.
I'm Ben, by the way. I'm guessing you're new here?
I'm Owen. Just transfered in from Ogden High. Any idea where Classroom 128 is?
American Lit with Mr. Dean? That's where I'm headed now. I'll take you there.
You are now playing as $ZOE.
$ZOE and Emily take their places on the volleyball court just as the bell rings.
So... What do you think of the new guy?
He seems nice.
You two were really cute together!
I was just being friendly! It's Owen's first day at a new school.
The teacher blows a whistle, and the girls form up into teams and start to play...
Anyway, I've got a problem that I could use your advice on.
What's up?
Emily dives for the ball and smacks it back across the net, winning the point.
Tomorrow will be the one month anniversary of when Ben and I started dating.
Aww!
Ben managed to get a reservation for us at that fancy fondue place across town... But to get there in time, we'd have to leave an hour before school is over.
Emily starts a new round, serving the ball.
I really want to go... But I'm not sure I should. I mean, my dad already thinks Ben is a bad influence... If he found out, we'd be in real trouble! What do you think? Would you skip class for a date?
Make your choice!
Sure, sometimes it's okay to break the rules.|No way! I'd never sneak out of class!
Would you skip class for a date?
Really?
I hate to say it, but I don't think it's a good idea to sneak off.
...So, you think I should make him cancel it?
Well... That's just what `I` would do. `You` should make your own choice about it. And from the look on your face, it seems to me like you're going to be eating some fondue.
Heh.
Score Up!
That date sounds `really` romantic, and it `is` a special occasion...
I was hoping you'd say that!
Look out!
$ZOE looks up to see a volleyball hurtling towards her!
Hurry!
Hit the ball!|Freeze!|Choke!
What do you do?
$ZOE freezes! The ball bounces off of her head!
`Ouch!`
And that's the game.
$ZOE slams the ball back!
Score Up!
Yes!
Nice! That's the game, girls.
$ZOE and Emily head out into the hallway for their next class when a girl in a cheerleading uniform rushes up to them.
Girls! I've got some serious gossip! Melissa Tancredo just got removed from being the school's Social Chair.
Apparently, she spent half the Homecoming budget on getting herself a $500 ball gown. She claimed it counted as a 'decoration' for the dance.
They're holding an emergency election to replace her!
Why is this a big deal, exactly?
Uh, are you kidding me? The Social Chair gets to plan all the school's dances, parties, and rallies! You basically `control` the social scene!
Huh... $ZOE, you should run!
Me? Why?
You're organized. You love decorating things. And everyone knows you'd never steal from the budget.
Besides, it might be just what you need to get out of your breakup funk.
What funk?
Come on, $ZOE, don't deny it! It's been four months since Howard left for college and left you high and dry!
And yes, he was basically the perfect boyfriend, so you're allowed to be all emo for a while... But now it's time to move on!
And `this` could be exactly what you need to make the final step!
It does sound like it would be a lot of fun...
I'd vote for $ZOE! And I know the rest of the squad would too. I know you'd make sure we always get the funding we need.
And the timing is perfect! $ZOE can make her announcement after the cheerleader's routine at the pep rally.
That's a great idea.
What do you think, $ZOE?
You're right. I've done enough wallowing. I'm ready for this.
You are now playing as Owen.
Owen follows Ben into a classroom. The two sit down next to an enormous guy in a football jersey.
'Sup Ben.
Hey, Spencer. This is Owen. He just transferred here.
Hey.
Mr. Dean walks to the front of the room and starts talking.
Now, `The Scarlet Letter` is one of the seminal works of early American literature, exploring, among other things, colonial views on `adultery...`
Spencer sizes Owen up and leans over to whisper...
You're a pretty built dude... One of our linebackers blew out his knee, and we could `really` use a replacement for the State Championship game on Friday...
Do you play football?
A memory flashes... Rain running down a helmet... The roar of the crowd... Hot lights shining down...
No. No, I don't. Never have.
Spencer here is on the team, if you couldn't guess... We're playing the three-time reigning Champions, the San Adino Warriors, but he still thinks we're going to win.
I guess it's good to be optimistic.
Just then, Mr. Dean clears his throat and looks right at Owen!
Ahem! `Owen,` is it? You certainly seem more interested in chatting with your new friends than paying attention to the lesson!
Oh, uh, I was paying attention...
Oh really? Then tell me, what did the `A` that Hester Prynne had to wear stand for?
Make your choice!
Arson.|Anger.|Adultery.|Avocado.
What do you say?
That... Is correct.
Score Up!
Well, yeah, it's correct! I told you I was paying attention!
I suppose you're off the hook... `This time.`
Mr. Dean grumbles and resumes his lecture. Ben leans over and whispers...
Nice!
Avocado?
Yep.
She had to wear a scarlet letter that stood for `avocado?`
That girl was `crazy` about avocados. She straight up had a problem.
Several students around Owen laugh.
I see you fancy yourself a comedian. Well, perhaps you can make me laugh later today...
In detention.
Awww...
A well-reasoned guess...
But `wrong.`
Awww...
Don't worry. You can figure it out for yourself when you read the book...
In detention.
Look, I don't want trouble. I didn't realize $ZOE was your girl.
Sure you didn't. I'll be keeping my eye on you, buddy. You just made the wrong enemy.
Nate shoves Owen again, then turns and storms off. As he leaves, a guy walks over.
Owen winds up and throws a hard right hook at Nate's head...
But Nate weaves under it!
Oh, you wanna fight now, huh?
Nate punches Owen hard in the side!
Ooof!
Owen slumps back down against the lockers. Nate turns away.
You just made the wrong enemy.
As Nate leaves, a guy walks over and helps Owen up.
Wow... Most transfer students are really shy on their first day...
Score Up!
I'm not most transfer students.
No... Apparently not. You're not about to kiss my hand or start reciting poetry, are you?
Would that work?
Absolutely not.
Heh. Nice to meet you. I'm Owen.
I'm $ZOE.
Wow, you're... Kind of gruff, aren't you?
Sorry. At my old school, you kind of had to be.
Is this one of those things where inmates try to look tough by beating up the biggest guy?
Because I should probably tell you, I'm not the best target...
Score Up!
Heh. Sorry. I guess old habits die hard.
It's okay. First days are always tough.
Tell me about it. I'm Owen. I just transfered here.
I'm $ZOE.
An hour later, Owen walks through the cafeteria, looking around at the crowded tables full of people talking...
OMG, Emily! The State Championship game is going to be the biggest social event of the year!
How can you even `think` about not going?
I've got swim practice, Kimi. You `know` how controlling my dad can get. He's not going to let me skip practice for a football game.
But... `State Championship!`
All right, all right, I'll see what I can do...
Owen stops at the edge of the cafeteria.
Thinking about where to sit, huh? Decisions, decisions.
Owen turns around. Sitting alone at a table behind him is a tall, scruffy guy.
You must be the new kid. Owen, is it?
Yeah, it is. I'm surprised you know my name. Most people just call me 'New Kid.'
Oh, I know a lot of things, friend.
I know you put Nate in his place...
And I know you showed up Mr. Dean in Lit class.
And I know Mr. Dean caught you off-guard and slapped you with a detention.
I know about everything that goes on here. The name's Wes. And I'm the best friend a new kid like you could have.
I'm here to help you out, fill you in on any gossip, and tell you anything you want to know.
Well... I am curious about...
Make your choice!
$ZOE.|Nate.
I am curious about...
Scoping out your rival, huh? I respect that.
Score Up!
I like to know what I'm up against.
The bad news is you're up against 175 pounds of muscle that throws the ball like he's got some kind of cyborg rocket laser arm.
Nate's the best QB we've ever had. He's superstar material. A natural winner. A guy who's going places.
That means most people are okay looking the other way when he does something a little crazy... Like, say, slam the new kid up against some lockers.

He went to the Homecoming Dance with $ZOE, and now he's got plans to make her his girlfriend... But the last time he asked, she turned him down. Said she wasn't ready for another serious relationship yet.
But he still feels... Protective of her. Oh, and he's the son of Mayor Crawford... Which means his family basically runs this town.
So basically... The worst possible enemy a guy could have. Thanks for the heads up.
Well, how about that? First day at your new school, and you've `already` got a crush.
What? No! I... I just wanted to know more about her...
Relax, new kid. Your secret's safe with me.
Now listen. $ZOE's a good girl. Real heart of gold, though it's not shining quite as bright since her main man, Howard, took off for college.

Since then, she's been kind of floating. She went to the Homecoming Dance with our star quarterback, Nate, but turned him down when he asked her out again. Said she wasn't ready for another serious relationship yet.
She likes cookies, lilies, and guys who care. She hates spiders, listens to top 40 pop, and once got detention for stealing the mice from the biology lab and setting them free.
That's... Very specific.
No worries, friend, that's what I'm here for! First one's free.
But next time... I expect you to pay.
Well, that was sketchy...
Owen turns away and looks out at the cafeteria, trying to spot an open seat. At a nearby table there is an open chair where a nerdy group is playing a board game...
My warrior is going to attack the dragon with the Vaporizing Sword of Death.
Ha! You think you can vaporize a fire dragon? Roll for initiative.
And at another table, there's an open spot near a group of hipsters looking at photographs...
Wow! How did you get this shot of the waterfall to come out so clearly?
...By taking 50 blurry ones first?
Who should I sit with?
Make your choice!
The nerds.|The hipsters.
Who do you sit with?
Owen walks over to the table where the hipsters are sitting...
Hey, I'm new here, and I was wondering if this seat's taken.
No one's sitting there.
You're welcome to join us. We were just looking at some of these photos for the yearbook.
Autumn slides a photo of a kitten playing in a Twin Branches sweatshirt over to Owen.
What do you think?
I really like, the... Um...
Make your choice!
The kitten.|The symbolism.
I like...
Owen walks over to the table where the nerds are sitting...
Hey, I'm new here, and I was wondering if this seat is taken.
No one's sitting there.
Sit and be welcomed!
But be warned... Those who sit here enter a world of magic, danger, and bravery!
I think I can handle it.
Very well. Ashleannderia, Eriksmythson! A new figure approaches you. His name is...
Make your choice!
Owengard.|Owenbot.
His name is...
Owenbot?
Yeah, you know... Like Owen but... A robot...
This is a mystical fantasy realm, Owen! There aren't any robots!
Oh.
Sorry, Owen, but you seem really out of your element.
...I guess this isn't really my usual thing.
It's okay! Not everyone is cut out to be a medieval warrior.
Excellent adventuring name!
Score Up!
Thanks!
Ahem. Owengard approaches...
Welcome, stranger, to our strange land!
Erik clasps Owen's hand.
Suddenly, a bright light flashes!
Nice! That's a great candid shot for the yearbook. Hope you guys don't mind.
Ahem! Historian, just be sure to caption it appropriately... 'Fight with Demon Dragon in Old Port Town.'
Of course. If I didn't write that, people might think you're just having lunch.
So much of history is lost because of poor historians.
Luckily for you, I take my job very seriously, Dexarius of Re'allen.
Very good, historian.
And I know Ashleannderia and Eriksmythson, but who is this new companion?
In real life, I'm Owen.
I'm Autumn. Nice to meet you.
Just then, the bell rings!
Time for the pep rally! I've got to grab my zoom lens!
The cafeteria clears out as everyone heads to the gym...
You are now playing as $ZOE.
The cheerleaders wait while people file in and take their seats.
Okay cheerleaders, don't forget to wait at the end of the pep rally for $ZOE to make her announcement about running for Social Chair.
And after school, we're going to help her make posters.
Good luck, $ZOE!
Yay, $ZOE!
Thanks, everyone! I `really` appreciate the squad supporting me. Now, let's get out there!
$ZOE and the cheerleaders run out to the center of the floor as music begins to play!
Hello, everyone! We know you're all excited about the big game at the end of the week!
It's the `Twin Branches Squirrels` versus the `San Adino Warriors...` And we're gonna show those Warriors just how tough us Squirrels can be!
Everyone in the gym cheers!
So let's get pumped up!
$ZOE steps up to the center of the group to lead the cheers...
Everyone, repeat after me!
Make your choice!
Choose the right cheers!
Go Squirrels!|Go! Fight! Win!|Go Twin Branches!|Beat the Warriors!
Go Warriors!|We can't win!|It's hopeless!|Vote Eisenhower!|Go Koalas?|Football's overrated!
Go... Um... What's our mascot again?
$ZOE, we're the Squirrels!
Right! Go Squirrels!
Just forget the cheers, let's skip to the dance routine.
Go Squirrels! Beat the Warriors! Woo!
The crowd cheers and chants along with the cheerleaders!
Now for the dance routine!
The cheerleaders twirl and jump in time to the music!
The routine ends with $ZOE being tossed into the air! Two guys catch her as she lands!
Go team!
The crowd claps as the cheerleaders clear away, and Nate steps up.
I'd like to take a moment to thank everyone for all of the support we've gotten.
The football team is working hard every day to train, and I promise you that trophy's gonna be ours!
Not just for the guys on the football team, but for each and every person at this school!
Yay! People!
Woo! Nate!
I'm `nuts` about squirrels!
The bell rings. Everyone stands to leave...
Wait, before everyone goes... I have an announcement to make!
Hey, everyone! Hold up and listen to $ZOE!
Thanks, Nate. As of today, I am officially running for the position of Social Chair!
Suddenly, blaring music cuts $ZOE off... A team of professional dancers run out onto the floor and start an elaborate routine!
What... Is going on?
The dancers part and at the center is a gorgeous girl in a designer dress!
Hello, beloved school! Sorry to interrupt, but I've got `big` news!
The dancers run up with t-shirt launchers! They fire into the audience, and Owen snags a shirt out of the air and reads it...
'Paige for Social Chair... She's Got Money'? What's with this girl?
She transferred here from Monarch Prep School for Privileged Girls at the beginning of the year.
Paige's parents have donated so much money to the school that they basically own it.
That's right, everybody! I'm running... And I'm ready to be the best Social Chair this school has ever seen!
You're running against me?
What? Did you say something? I couldn't hear you over the sound of my `awesome back-up dancers!`
But... You don't even really care about the school!
So what? I throw awesome parties! In fact, I'm planning a mega party after Friday's game...
And `everyone's` invited!
Nice!
Paige is `so` cool!
After the pep rally, $ZOE and the cheerleaders gather outside the gym.
Okay, I know Paige is going to be really tough to beat, but--
Tough? Try impossible! I can't believe this is happening.
It's bad enough she interrupted our rally... But if she's the new Social Chair, we can forget about getting any funding for the rest of the year. Paige is just going to blow it all on parties!
When she's the Social Chair, we're all going to be ruined unless we start trying to get on her good side `immediately...`
Wait a second. What are you talking about? You guys said you'd help me!
I'm sorry, $ZOE. But let's be honest. If Paige is running, you don't have a chance. We can't risk the squad supporting you when your campaign is already doomed.
Make your choice!
You're all cowards!|I understand your position.
What do you say?
Score Up!
I don't like it, but... You guys have to look out for the squad.
Exactly. You're `so` understanding, $ZOE.
She'd make a great Social Chair!
Too soon, Amanda. Too soon.
Good luck, $ZOE. I'm sorry it has to be this way. For what it's worth, Amanda `is` right. I know you'd make a better Social Chair than Paige.
...Thanks.
I can't believe you'd just give up like that!
